description:
Every extension this token's owner tracks, with each store listing's
latest numbers: user count (and whether the store rounded it), the
7-day change, rating, ratings count and category rank.

Start here when this connection has an account: every tracking tool
takes an extension_id from this list.

Needs an ExtensionDash account: sign in from your app, e.g. `claude mcp login extensions-dashboard` or `codex mcp login extensions-dashboard`.
name: list_extensions
title: List extensions
